# README mockups

These three concept images were generated with the built-in image tool on 2026-10-28.
They are illustrations, not photographs of hardware tests. Each carries a `Concept mockup` label.

- `galaxy-watch3-workbench.png`: launcher beside a build terminal; the main README image.
- `galaxy-watch3-wrist-at-keyboard.png`: orange clock at a desk.
- `galaxy-watch3-launcher-detail.png`: launcher close-up.

The screen references are earlier PebbleOS captures from this project. `reference-launcher.png`
was captured as `pebble-first-frame.png`; `reference-clock.png` as `pebble-controls-verified.png`.
They do not establish protocol-v2 hardware behavior. The watch case and scenes are generated.

[prompts.json](prompts.json) contains the complete prompts and reference-image mapping.
